title: Chapter 2828 - 131: Mr. Tu?
content:
Chapter 2828: Chapter 131: Mr. Tu?

But... how is this possible? Struck by robbery thunder, how could he not die?

Unless...

Mo Hua furrowed his brows, relying on his keen intuition to immediately form a hypothesis:

"Unless this Mr. Tu doesn’t have just one life..."

Mo Hua’s heart was slightly shaken.

As the top henchman of the Great Wilderness Evil God, no one knows how long Mr. Tu has lived, how many times he has shed his skin, or how many bodies he has possessed.

He can sever his physical form, perhaps he can also sever his Divine Sense.

The robbery thunder killed only one of his lives.

If he has other lives, naturally, he can still live.

As long as there is a physical body embryo, his memories remain, his heritage remains, and his faith in the Great Wilderness Evil God remains, he can "live" again.

Though somewhat unbelievable, when it comes to Mr. Tu, it is certainly not impossible.

A centipede dies but does not stiffen; one cannot underestimate the Tao cultivation knowledge and experiences of these ancient monsters who have abandoned human principles and lived for a long, long time.

"I didn’t expect that in the end, it turned out to be an ’old acquaintance’..."

Mo Hua muttered in his heart, unable to help but think again: "If it is indeed Mr. Tu... what is his purpose?"

"Does he still intend... to resurrect the Great Wilderness Evil God?"

In Qian Learning State Boundary, Mr. Tu’s plans failed, but it doesn’t matter; life always has failures, if the green hills remain, there will be wood to burn, after a fall one must get up, life’s path must continue, so he intends to make a comeback in the Great Wilderness, to reestablish plans, for the advent of the Master of the Great Wilderness, to bend his utmost efforts once more..."

Mo Hua surprisingly felt a trace of "respect" for Mr. Tu.

Even though this Mr. Tu committed all sorts of evil, his faith is truly devoted, and he is highly persevering, unyielding for his ideals.

People like this, in whatever they do, can mostly succeed.

If not for his insistence on resurrecting the Evil God, and if he hadn’t just encountered me...

But the problem is...

This Great Wilderness is Uncle’s territory, right?

Can Mr. Tu really resurrect the Great Wilderness Evil God under Uncle’s watchful eyes?

The difficulty of this is many times greater than resurrecting the Evil God in Qian Learning State Boundary.

Mo Hua furrowed his brows again, thinking for a moment, he suddenly realized a problem: since this Great Wilderness is Uncle’s territory, Mr. Tu’s movements, his actions, surely can’t be hidden from Uncle.

Were Mr. Tu’s actions "tacitly approved" by Uncle?

No, further speaking, perhaps... Mr. Tu’s actions were "ordered" by Uncle?

Is Mr. Tu now helping Uncle with his affairs?

Mo Hua felt a chill in his heart, difficult to believe for a moment, but as he thought thoroughly, the more he considered, the more reasonable it seemed.

In this way, many things can be explained.

Even in Qian Learning State Boundary, many perplexing issues that Mo Hua had encountered can be roughly explained.

Including the Shen Family mine incident, the sinking of Gushan Temple, and the various changes, the eerie and weird feelings he sensed.

Uncle might have been secretly involved, exerting influence on them all.

Including Mr. Tu being struck dead by robbery thunder...

Now thinking back, Mo Hua felt this was very likely Uncle’s covert handiwork.

The Quasi-Third Grade Evil Path Large Formation was indeed explosively powerful when I disintegrated and detonated it, but couldn’t those in the Feather Transformation Realm resist it? Wouldn’t they run?

How could they have been truly forced to the point of losing control of their cultivation, violating Heavenly Dao’s taboo, and dying from heavenly tribulation?

But if Uncle intervened, then it would be an entirely different matter.

It was Uncle who caused their deaths.

Moreover, it was orchestrated for these cultivators in the Feather Transformation Realm to die in the collapse of the Desolate Heaven Blood Sacrifice Formation that I was responsible for.

The cause and effect of these Feather Transformation deaths became a substantial weight, along with the countless vengeful spirits, burdened upon my Life Chart.

Thus, everything can be explained.

The more Mo Hua thought, the chillier his heart grew.

Is Mr. Tu now, on the soil of the Great Wilderness, on Uncle’s chessboard, continuing to spread the evil path, and nurturing the Evil God was also Uncle’s intention?

Has Mr. Tu transitioned from a follower of the Master of the Great Wilderness to being Uncle’s "puppet"?

Was it Mr. Tu who corrupted the Barbarian God, so what about the Famine Disaster Formation?

Could it also have Mr. Tu quietly orchestrating it? Advancing it?

Mo Hua suddenly remembered that in Qian Learning State Boundary, Mr. Tu was constructing blood sacrifice arrays and nurturing the Evil God...

Now returning to the Great Wilderness, he is advancing the Famine Disaster Formation, polluting the Evil God...

Could this also be considered... a match of profession and experience?

Uncle precisely appreciated this in Mr. Tu, thus set up to kill one of his lives; then designed to guide the remaining life of Mr. Tu to the Great Wilderness, to set up the large formation for him, inflict the famine, nurture the Evil God, bringing calamities?

In an instant, Mo Hua’s thoughts whirled, linking these all together, and he couldn’t help but shiver.

So many intricate connections were hidden within matters he hadn’t thought through.

Uncle’s plotting is truly unfathomable.

These are what I can think of now. What about those that I haven’t thought of or experienced, are there any shadows of Uncle there too?

This is indeed the "mysterious" Taoist as rumored...

Mo Hua’s expression became extremely grave.

Beside him, Lugu and Chi Feng, for the first time, saw this worldly demon and divine Shaman in their hearts showing such a grave and even somewhat terrifying expression.

Mo Hua regained his senses and looked at Elder She.

"Mr. Tu... She..."

He suddenly remembered that back in Qian Learning State Boundary, when he entered the small fishing village of the Evil God to save Little Shunzi and Little Shuizi, he did encounter someone who claimed to be "Master She."
